# Fairytale / OmniAnalytics

OmniAnalytics is a unified engineering workspace for planning, building, shipping, and operating software.

Canonical site: https://fairytale.omixsystems.store/

## Public routes
- / — Public landing page
- /login — Authentication entry point
- /signup — Account registration entry point

## Private application
Dashboard, projects, project details, issues, repositories, CI/CD, releases, integrations, analytics, security, docs, settings, and profile routes are protected by authentication and are intentionally excluded from the public sitemap and crawler content.
